Privacy policy

Short, because there is little to say: static pages, analytics, a booking link and an email address.

Get a quoteView services & pricing

What this site collects

This site is a set of static pages. It uses the following third-party tags, loaded through Google Tag Manager:

  • Google Analytics 4. Measures visits, pages viewed and clicks on the booking and email links, to understand which pages are useful. Sets first-party cookies (_ga, _ga_*). Data is processed by Google under Google's privacy policy.
  • Google Ads conversion measurement. When you arrive from a Google ad and send the form, the enquiry is reported back to Google Ads as a conversion so ad spend can be judged on real outcomes.

You can block these with your browser's tracking protection or an extension such as Google's Analytics opt-out; the site works the same without them.

  • Contact form. What you type in the form is relayed to my inbox by Web3Forms and is not stored on this site. I use it only to reply.
  • Email. Messages to hello@diwizi.com go to Diego Zietek directly and are kept for the purpose of replying and, if you become a client, running the engagement.
  • Hosting. Pages are served by Cloudflare, which processes IP addresses and request logs to deliver the site and protect it from abuse.

Your rights

You can ask what personal data I hold about you, ask for it to be corrected or deleted, or object to its use, by emailing hello@diwizi.com. Requests are answered by the same person who received your original message.

Controller

Diego Zietek, operating as Diwizi, Curitiba, Brazil. Contact: hello@diwizi.com.

Tell me about the account

Spend band, site and what is not working. You get a straight answer on whether I can help, what I would do first and a price range. No proposal deck, no sales follow-up sequence.

Monthly ad spend, roughly
One reply, from me, usually within a working day. No sequence.
